title: DOE Genesis project

tellings.quote: And now the Department of Energy has this Genesis project which is sort of I think a way to collate and collect all the information from all of the national labs and run it through AI

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that the Department of Energy, the US agency that runs the country's national science laboratories, now has something called the Genesis project. As he understands it, the project is a way to gather all the information from all the national labs and run it through artificial intelligence, which would put an enormous store of secret science in one place.
